title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Claude Code 2.1.310: Monitor tool reaches Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry; gateway and compaction fixes
bullets.summary: Released 23 Oct, one day after 2.1.309; brings the Monitor tool to third-party cloud providers and fixes gateway failures and stubborn compaction (page summary is partial).
bullets.how: The Construct: bump Mac runners from 2.1.309 to 2.1.310 and re-test long-running sessions that hit compaction. PRAGMA: Monitor on Bedrock/Vertex helps enterprise client deployments. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 launched at $0.10/$0.50 per million tokens
bullets.summary: Per a weekly LLM tracker, Haiku 5.5 (7 Oct) is roughly 75% cheaper than Haiku 4.5 on average.
bullets.how: The Construct: move high-volume cheap steps (triage, tagging, Pulse-style scans) to Haiku 5.5 to cut cost. Brand 9 Signs: maybe, for bulk product-copy and alt-text jobs. PRAGMA: cost story for client agent stacks.

bullets.title: Meta, Sierra, Walmart and Stripe announce Personal Agent Protocol (OAuth for agents)
bullets.summary: An OAuth-based standard (6 Oct) for how agents sign in to businesses on a user's behalf; same tracker also notes Gemini 4 Argon reached developers on 13 Oct at $2/$10 per million tokens.
bullets.how: The Construct: watch as a possible answer to agent-credential handling alongside MCP auth. PRAGMA: client-facing talking point on agent identity. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Google previews a Gemini agent with its own Workspace identity, audit logs and admin controls
bullets.summary: Private preview announced 8 Oct; no GA date (per the same weekly tracker).
bullets.how: The Construct: model for giving our agents distinct identities and audit trails. PRAGMA: enterprise governance pitch. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: TrueFoundry raises $19M Series A for agent/LLMOps gateway; Goodweek launches an SMB 'AI Manager'
bullets.summary: Week-ending 20 Oct startup roundup lists both; no exact dates or primary article links given.
bullets.how: The Construct: gateway layer validates our need for a central routing/cost/access control point. PRAGMA: Goodweek is a small-business competitor to track. Brand 9 Signs: no.

praxis_lesson: Agent identity, audit and credentials are becoming first-class product surfaces (Meta's protocol, Google's agent identity, gateway funding), so give every Construct agent a distinct, logged identity and a central gateway now rather than retrofitting it.
